# Live AI review for PRs in this repository (ubuntu-latest, --no-sandbox).
# Portable template for other repos: ci/ai-review.yml (expects tools/review.py).
# This checkout keeps review.py at the repo root, so the job reads BASE:review.py.
#
# Isolation: ubuntu-latest is a fresh VM thrown away after the job, so review.py runs with
# --no-sandbox (no srt). The model's commands can reach the checkout, LLM_API_KEY in this
# process, and the internet. Use a model key with a spending limit; keep permissions read-only.
#
# Why not GitHub Copilot in Actions?
#   Official docs wire Copilot CLI (prompt in → text/agent out) with GITHUB_TOKEN and
#   permissions: copilot-requests: write, or the Copilot SDK / server-to-server path.
#   That is not an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions base URL with tool_calls for a
#   custom Python loop, so it cannot drive review.py.
#   Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-cli/use-copilot-cli-in-actions
#         https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-sdk/auth/server-to-server-tokens
#   GitHub Models (models.github.ai) was retired 2026-07-30.
#
# Real model in CI: call Zhipu GLM-5.3 directly (OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions + tools).
#   vars.LLM_BASE_URL   = https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4
#   vars.AI_REVIEW_MODEL = glm-5.3
#   secrets.LLM_API_KEY  = Zhipu API key (Bearer)
#   Docs: https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/guide/develop/openai/introduction
#         https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/guide/models/text/glm-5.3
name: ai-review
on:
  pull_request:                     # never pull_request_target: that would run PR code with the base repo's secrets
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
permissions:
  contents: read                    # the job only reads code
jobs:
  review:
    # Same-repository PRs only. Fork PRs get no secrets anyway; skip them instead of failing.
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      LLM_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.LLM_BASE_URL }}            # https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4
      LLM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LLM_API_KEY }}           # Zhipu API key
      AI_REVIEW_MODEL: ${{ vars.AI_REVIEW_MODEL }}      # glm-5.3
      BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
      HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0                # full history: base and head commits must both be present
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require model endpoint configuration
        run: |
          if [ -z "$LLM_BASE_URL" ] || [ -z "$AI_REVIEW_MODEL" ] || [ -z "$LLM_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo "::error title=AI review config::Set vars.LLM_BASE_URL=https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4, vars.AI_REVIEW_MODEL=glm-5.3, and secrets.LLM_API_KEY (Zhipu). Official Copilot-in-Actions is CLI/SDK only and cannot drive review.py."
            exit 2
          fi
      - name: Take review.py from the base commit, not from the PR
        run: git show "$BASE:review.py" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/review.py"
      - name: Review base...head
        run: |
          set +e
          python3 -I "$RUNNER_TEMP/review.py" --no-sandbox --model "$AI_REVIEW_MODEL" \
            --base "$BASE" --head "$HEAD" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ai-review.json"
          rc=$?
          python3 -c 'import json, sys; d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); open(sys.argv[2], "w").write("".join(p["diff"] for p in d.get("patches", [])))' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/ai-review.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/ai-review.patch" 2>/dev/null
          case $rc in
            0) echo "AI review passed" ;;
            1) echo "::error title=AI review::blocking findings, see the ai-review artifact"; exit 1 ;;
            # exit 2 is "did not finish", and it covers both a model that never concluded and an
            # infrastructure failure (rejected key, unreachable endpoint, missing review.py). Only forgive
            # the first one: the report holds the model's own messages, so it says whether the model ran.
            # A bad key or a dead endpoint leaves no assistant turn behind and must fail the job.
            2) if python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); sys.exit(0 if any(m.get("role")=="assistant" for m in d.get("messages",[])) else 1)' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ai-review.json" 2>/dev/null; then
                 echo "::warning title=AI review incomplete::the model did not conclude; not blocking, see the ai-review artifact"
               else
                 echo "::error title=AI review failed::exit 2 before the model ran (endpoint, key or review.py problem)"; exit 2
               fi ;;
            *) echo "::error title=AI review failed::exit $rc"; exit "$rc" ;;
          esac
      - name: Upload report and suggested patches
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ai-review
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ai-review.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ai-review.patch
          if-no-files-found: ignore

exit 1

[![demo](https://github.com/weiping/local-code-review/actions/workflows/demo.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/weiping/local-code-review/actions/workflows/demo.yml)

`review.py` 是一个在自己机器上运行的 AI 代码审查脚本，单文件、只用 Python 标准库，共 378 行（以 `wc -l` 为准）。它通过 OpenAI 兼容的 chat completions 接口调用模型（默认是本机的 [Magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) 网关 `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1`），模型发出的每条命令都在 Anthropic 的 [sandbox-runtime](https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime)（srt）里跑。模型先跑代码确认 bug，再以补丁形式给出修复；补丁不进沙箱，加 `--apply` 才写回工作区。

博客正文《给 AI 代码审查配一个能跑代码的沙箱》讲设计和取舍，本仓库是配套代码和测试。改编自 OpenRouter 官方博客 [Build an AI Code Reviewer with OpenRouter (Python)](https://openrouter.ai/blog/tutorials/ai-code-review/)（2026-11-01）。

| 文件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `review.py` | 审查脚本 |
| `fake_llm.py` | 按剧本返回工具调用的假模型服务。剧本里的检查命令会在 srt 沙箱里真跑，只有"判断"是写死的 |
| `run_demo.sh` | 用假模型跑完全部机制用例，逐条判定 PASS/FAIL |
| `fixtures/make_repo.sh` | 生成示例仓库：先提交一个干净版本，再在工作区留下 5 个埋点 bug，外加一个重命名后又修改的文件、一个约 288 KiB 只改了一行的数据文件、一个未跟踪的新文件 |

## 前置条件

- macOS 或 Linux，Python 3.9 或更高版本（macOS 自带的 3.9.6 可用），Git，Node.js 22.12 或更高版本（srt 0.0.81 的 `engines` 要求；Debian 13 自带的 20.19、Ubuntu 24.04 自带的 18.19 都不够，用 NodeSource 或 nvm 装）。
- srt：`npm install -g @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime@0.0.81`。srt 是 Beta 研究预览，配置格式可能变化，建议固定版本。
- macOS 还要 ripgrep：`brew install ripgrep`。
- Linux 还要 bubblewrap、socat、ripgrep：`sudo apt-get install bubblewrap socat ripgrep`。Ubuntu 24.04 及以上还要 `sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0`；Debian 没有这个参数，不用设。
- 演示里有两例要连 pypi.org（测 `--allow-domain`），需要联网。
- Windows 没有测过。

#!/bin/sh
# AI review before every push. Needs AI_REVIEW_MODEL; AI_REVIEW_CONTEXT and AI_REVIEW_ON_INCOMPLETE are optional.
# git runs hooks from the repo root, so a .env there is picked up automatically.

zero=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
status=0
while read -r lref lsha rref rsha; do
  [ "$lsha" = "$zero" ] && continue                  # deleting a branch: nothing to review
  if [ "$rsha" = "$zero" ]; then                     # new branch: compare with where it left origin/main
    base=$(git merge-base "$lsha" origin/main 2>/dev/null) || continue
  else
    base=$rsha
  fi
  python3 -I review.py --model "$AI_REVIEW_MODEL" --base "$base" --head "$lsha" \

  rc=$?

    echo "AI review incomplete, pushing anyway" >&2
    rc=0
  fi
  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && status=1
done
exit $status

def edit_file(root, originals, op):
    path = inside(root, op["path"])
    text = path.read_text()
    found = text.count(op["old_str"]) if op["old_str"] else 0
    if found != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"old_str must occur exactly once in {op['path']}, found {found}")
    originals.setdefault(op["path"], text)
    path.write_text(text.replace(op["old_str"], op["new_str"], 1))


def create_file(root, originals, op):
    path = inside(root, op["path"])
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"file already exists: {op['path']} (use edit_file to change it)")
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    originals.setdefault(op["path"], None)  # None marks a file the review created
    path.write_text(op["content"])


def delete_file(root, originals, op):
    path = inside(root, op["path"])
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"no such file: {op['path']}")
    originals.setdefault(op["path"], path.read_text())
    path.unlink()

        names = [os.fsdecode(f) for f in git("diff", "--name-only", "-z", "--diff-filter=AMR", rng).split(b"\0") if f]
        files = {n: git("show", f"{a.head}:{n}") for n in names}
    else:  # working tree against base, plus untracked files
        diff = git("diff", a.base).decode(errors="replace")
        names = [os.fsdecode(f) for f in git("diff", "--name-only", "-z", "--diff-filter=AMR", a.base).split(b"\0") if f]
        if a.untracked:
            for n in git("ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z").split(b"\0"):
                n = os.fsdecode(n)
                if not n or (top / n).resolve() == me:
                    continue
                p = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--no-index", "--", os.devnull, n], capture_output=True)
                diff += p.stdout.decode(errors="replace")
                names.append(n)
        files = {n: (top / n).read_bytes() for n in names}
    for c in a.context:
        rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(a.cwd, c)), top)
        files.setdefault(rel, (top / rel).read_bytes())
    return diff, files
